scenes.stage_direction: Victor's commands meet increasingly specific questions he cannot answer. His uncertainty must not be played as proof Ethan is safe.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The handler has refused to complete the new instruction.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: A person can still stop when they learn the truth.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We need the stopped document and its transport record before someone replaces it.

metadata.evidence_summary: Continued participation cannot be called innocent misunderstanding.
